revision.comment: 各国の式内社表の掲載。ただし、式内比定社は現在名神大社のみの状態、国史見在社・式外社も未掲載の状態。
revision.text:
'''上野国の式内社一覧'''（こうずけのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[上野国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社3座3社（いずれも名神大社）・小社9座9社の計12座12社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[片岡郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''小祝神社'''||ヲハフリノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[甘楽郡]]''' 2座（大1座・小1座） |- |'''貫前神社'''||ヌキノサキノ

'''上野国の式内社一覧'''（こうずけのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[上野国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社3座3社（いずれも名神大社）・小社9座9社の計12座12社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[片岡郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''小祝神社'''||ヲハフリノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[甘楽郡]]''' 2座（大1座・小1座） |- |'''貫前神社'''||ヌキノサキノ

'''上野国の式内社一覧'''（こうずけのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[上野国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社3座3社（いずれも名神大社）・小社9座9社の計12座12社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[片岡郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''小祝神社'''||ヲハフリノ||小||||[[小祝神社]]||[[群馬県]][[高崎市]]石原町||七宮|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[甘楽郡]]''' 2座（大1座・小1座） |- |'''貫前神社'''||ヌキノサキノ

'''上野国の式内社一覧'''（こうずけのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[上野国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社3座3社（いずれも名神大社）・小社9座9社の計12座12社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[片岡郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''小祝神社'''||ヲハフリノ||小||||[[小祝神社]]||[[群馬県]][[高崎市]]石原町||七宮|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[甘楽郡]]''' 2座（大1座・小1座） |- |'''貫前神社'''||ヌキノサキノ

'''上野国の式内社一覧'''（こうずけのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[上野国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社3座3社（いずれも名神大社）・小社9座9社の計12座12社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[片岡郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''小祝神社'''||ヲハフリノ||小||||[[小祝神社]]||[[群馬県]][[高崎市]]石原町||七宮|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[甘楽郡]]''' 2座（大1座・小1座） |- |'''貫前神社'''||ヌキノサキノ

'''上野国の式内社一覧'''（こうずけのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[上野国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社3座3社（いずれも名神大社）・小社9座9社の計12座12社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[片岡郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''小祝神社'''||ヲハフリノ||小||||[[小祝神社]]||[[群馬県]][[高崎市]]石原町||上野国七宮|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[甘楽郡]]''' 2座（大1座・小1座） |- |'''貫前神社'''||ヌキノサキノ

'''上野国の式内社一覧'''（こうずけのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[上野国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社3座3社（いずれも名神大社）・小社9座9社の計12座12社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[片岡郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''小祝神社'''||ヲハフリノ||小||||[[小祝神社]]||[[群馬県]][[高崎市]]石原町||上野国七宮|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[甘楽郡]]''' 2座（大1座・小1座） |- |'''貫前神社'''||ヌキノサキノ

'''上野国の式内社一覧'''（こうずけのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[上野国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社3座3社（いずれも名神大社）・小社9座9社の計12座12社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[片岡郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''小祝神社'''||ヲハフリノ||小||||[[小祝神社]]||[[群馬県]][[高崎市]]石原町||上野国七宮|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[甘楽郡]]''' 2座（大1座・小1座） |- |'''貫前神社'''||ヌキノサキノ

'''上野国の式内社一覧'''（こうずけのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[上野国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社3座3社（いずれも名神大社）・小社9座9社の計12座12社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[{{NDLDC|1442211}} 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[片岡郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''小祝神社'''||ヲハフリノ||小||||[[小祝神社]]||[[群馬県]][[高崎市]]石原町||上野国七宮|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[甘楽郡]]''' 2座（大1座・小1座） |- |'''貫前神社'''||ヌキノサキノ

'''上野国の式内社一覧'''（こうずけのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[上野国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式』神名帳では、大社3座3社（いずれも名神大社）・小社9座9社の計12座12社を記載。 {{式内社一覧/凡例}} {{式内社一覧/header}} |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[片岡郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''小祝神社'''||ヲハフリノ||小||||[[小祝神社]]||[[群馬県]][[高崎市]]石原町||上野国七宮|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[甘楽郡]]''' 2座（大1座・小1座） |- |'''貫前神社'''||ヌキノサキノ

'''上野国の式内社一覧'''（こうずけのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[上野国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式』神名帳では、大社3座3社（いずれも名神大社）・小社9座9社の計12座12社を記載。 {{式内社一覧/凡例}} {{式内社一覧/header}} |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[片岡郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''小祝神社'''||ヲハフリノ||小||||[[小祝神社]]||[[群馬県]][[高崎市]]石原町||上野国七宮|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[甘楽郡]]''' 2座（大1座・小1座） |- |'''貫前神社'''||ヌキノサキノ

'''上野国の式内社一覧'''（こうずけのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[上野国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式』神名帳では、大社3座3社（いずれもMyojin Taisha社）・小社9座9社の計12座12社を記載。 {{式内社一覧/凡例}} {{List of Shikinai Shrines/header}} |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[片岡郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''小祝神社'''||ヲハフリノ||Shikinai Shosha||||[[小祝神社]]||[[群馬県]][[高崎市]]石原町||上野国七宮|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[甘楽郡]]''' 2座（大1座・小1座） |- |'''貫前神社'''||ヌキノサキノ

Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}''. Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinai Shrines/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}} ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | Designated Shrines ! style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | Compilation |- style="white-space:nowrap;" ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.6em; padding-left:2.6em;" | Shrine Name ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Reading ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Rank ! style="background:#a0f0a0;" | Note ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.6em; padding-left:2.6em;" | Shrine Name ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Location ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.3em; padding-left:2.3em;" | Remarks |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''{{ill|Kataoka District|de|Kataoka Bezirk|ja|片岡郡|zh|片岡郡}}''' 1 group (minor) |- |'''{{ill|Koshiwai Shrine|de|Koshiwai Shrine|ja|小祝神社|zh|小祝神社}}''' || wohafurino || Shikinai Shosha || ||{{ill|Koshiwai Shrine|de|Koshiwai Shrine|ja|小祝神社|zh|小祝神社}}|| {{ill|Gunma Prefecture|de|Gunma Präfektur|ja|群馬県|zh|群馬県}} {{ill|Takasaki City|de|Takasaki Stadt|ja|高崎市|zh|高崎市}} Ishiharamachi || Seventh Shrine of Ueno Province || |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''{{ill|Kanra District|de|Kanra Bezirk|ja|甘楽郡|zh|甘楽郡}}''' 2 groups (1 major, 1 minor) |- |'''{{ill|Nukizaki Shrine|de|Nukizaki Shrine|ja|貫前神社|zh|貫前神社}}''' || nukinosakino

Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinai Shrines/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinai Shrines/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinai Shrines/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinai Shrines/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinai Shrines/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinai Shrines/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinai Shrines/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinai Shrines/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinai Shrines/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinai Shrines/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinai Shrines/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province''' is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10, "[[Engishiki Jinmyocho]]", of the ''{{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}}''. These include the shrines known as ''{{ill|Shikinai Shrine|de|Shikinai-Schrein|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|12=draft}}'' and their related ''{{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社|12=draft}}'', which are classified under ''{{ill|Ueno Province|de|Ueno-Provinz|ja|上野国|zh|上野国|12=draft}}''. Additionally, it also notes the shrines that existed at the time the ''Engishiki'' Kamimyōchō was compiled but were not recorded therein, the so-called ''{{ill|Shikigai Shrine|de|Shikigai-Schrein|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}}''. == Shikinai-sha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Kōzuke Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Lists of Shikinaisha by location]] == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.[[Category:edited lists]] [[Category:Lists of Shikinaisha by location]] == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.[[Category:edited lists]] [[Category:Lists of Shikinaisha by location]] == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.[[Category:edited lists]] [[Category:Lists of Shikinaisha by location]] == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.[[Category:edited lists]] [[Category:Lists of Shikinaisha by location]] == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.[[Category:edited lists]] [[Category:Lists of Shikinaisha by location]] == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. [[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! [[Category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[Category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Kōzuke Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Kōzuke Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Kōzuke Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinaisha (式内社) == In the “Engishiki Jinmyōchō”, a total of 12 groups comprising 3 groups of major shrines (all Myojin Taisha shrines) and 9 groups of minor shrines are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" !
